title: Window & Door Open-Duration Heat Loss
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=structural:tilt event=opening OR sourcetype=alarm:event event=opening
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(open_min) as open_min by opening _time
| where open_min>60
| sort - open_min
description: Totals how long windows and external doors were left open in cold weather, quantifying heat lost.
value: A door left ajar bleeds heat and money; totalling open-time makes an invisible waste visible.
implementation: Ingest contact-sensor open durations into `index=personal`; flag openings left open a long time.
visualization: Column chart of daily open-duration by window or door.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up how long windows and doors were left open in the cold, showing where heat is escaping.
